def is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool:
    """True when name is one safe path component: non-empty, not "." or "..", and free of "/", "\\", ":" and NUL characters."""
    ex is_plain_name("todo.txt") == True
    ex is_plain_name("") == False
    ex is_plain_name("..") == False
    ex is_plain_name(".") == False
    ex is_plain_name("../secret") == False
    ex is_plain_name("a/b") == False
    ex is_plain_name("/etc/passwd") == False
    ex is_plain_name("a\\b") == False
    ex is_plain_name("C:x") == False
    if name == "" or name == "." or name == "..":
        return False
    for c in name.chars():
        if c == "/" or c == "\\" or c == ":" or c == "\0":
            return False
    return True

def read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Text of the file `name` inside the directory `notes`, read through fs confined to `notes`. A name that is not a plain name, or a missing or unreadable file, gives an empty string. No name can reach a file outside `notes`."""
    post out == "" or is_plain_name(name)
    if not is_plain_name(name):
        return ""
    text = ""
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        text = fs.read_text(name) else ""
    return text
